attempts.certificate: 将 O=K，化简得 K=¬s∨q；r 不影响输出。因此 q 为“+”时 s 可任意，q 为“-”时必须 s 为“-”，r 均可任意，共 6 组。

judges.reason: The expression simplifies as K=¬(s∧¬q)=¬s∨q. Thus q=+ allows either s value, while q=- requires s=-; r is unrestricted. The attempt lists exactly the six satisfying assignments, differing only in ordering and using semicolons within groups instead of the canonical comma formatting.
judges.depth_evidence: First simplify the repeated conjunction and apply negation; then split on q and enumerate the unrestricted r and permitted s values.
judges.explanation_evidence: The certificate explicitly derives K=¬s∨q, identifies that r is irrelevant, gives the correct q/s conditions, and counts the resulting six assignments.
